ADCB 365 Cashback Credit Card -
                 Cashback Eligibility Guide


                 This guide outlines the eligible Home Digital Entertainment merchants, AI-powered
                 subscriptions, and Select category spends for cashback earnings.

                 Home Digital Entertainment Subscriptions

                 5% cashback on spends made on eligible subscriptions under the following service providers
                 (as may be updated from time to time):

                 •   Netflix
                 •   Amazon Prime Video
                 •   Disney+
                 •   Apple TV+
                 •   Google Play Movies & TV
                 •   Starzplay
                 •   OSN+
                 •   Shahid
                 •   beIN Connect
                 •   Istikana
                 •   Anghami Video
                 •   WATCH iT!

                 5% cashback on AI-powered subscriptions

                 5% cashback applies on eligible subscriptions under the following service providers (as may
                 be updated from time to time):

                 •   ChatGPT
                 •   Microsoft Copilot
                 •   Google Gemini
                 •   Claude
                 •   Perplexity AI

                 NOTE: Cashback on home digital entertainment subscriptions and AI-powered subscriptions
Ver.01/Jun2026   is applicable only when transactions are made directly with the respective service providers.
                 Transactions routed through third-party platforms, app stores, or aggregators (e.g., iTunes,
                 Google Play, etc.) will not be eligible for cashback.




                                                              -1-
 5% cashback on Fuel and Salik spends

Note: Salik transactions will qualify for cashback only when payments are made directly
through the service provider’s channels (such as the Salik app or website) or via the Dubai
Now mobile application

0.5% cashback on select category spends

0.5% cashback applies on eligible spends across the following select categories

•   Utilities
•   Charity
•   Government payments
•   Telecom
•   Transport
•   Auto dealers
•   Education
•   Insurance
•   Real estate
•   Housing rentals

IMPORTANT NOTES

•   Bill payments, school fees, and transactions made through any ADCB channel are not
    eligible for cashback. However, such transactions will be included for the purpose of
    meeting the Minimum Spend Requirement.
•   Cashback is calculated based on merchant category codes (MCCs) as assigned by the
    merchant’s acquiring bank and card schemes.
•   Select category spends are identified based on Merchant Category Codes (MCC) assigned
    by the card network from time to time.
•   ADCB reserves the right to update the list of eligible categories and merchants/service
    providers.
